title: Absolute Value Equations and Inequalities
seo_title: Algebra 1 Absolute Value Equations and Inequalities Worksheets (Free, Answer Key)
standard_text: Create equations and inequalities in one variable and use them to solve problems.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 1 absolute value worksheets (A-CED.A.1, A-REI.B.3): solve absolute value equations with two, one or no solutions, isolate the absolute value first, and solve and/or absolute value inequalities and tolerance problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Isolate the absolute value, then split: |A| = k means A = k or A = −k.
key_sub: |A| < k is an and inequality; |A| > k is an or inequality. A negative k means no solution (or all numbers).
body_html:
How it works

|x| is the distance of x from 0, so it is never negative. |x| = 5 has two solutions, 5 and −5.

To solve an absolute value equation: isolate the absolute value, then split it into two equations: |A| = k means A = k or A = −k. If k is negative, there is no solution.

For inequalities: |A| < k becomes −k < A < k (an and, “less thAND”). |A| > k becomes A < −k or A > k (“greatOR”).

Example

Solve 2|x − 3| + 1 = 9.

Subtract 1 and divide by 2: |x − 3| = 4.

x − 3 = 4 or x − 3 = −4.

Answer: x = 7 or x = −1

Example

Solve |x + 2| < 5.

−5 < x + 2 < 5.

Subtract 2 from every part.

Answer: −7 < x < 3

Example

Solve |x − 1| ≥ 4.

x − 1 ≤ −4 or x − 1 ≥ 4.

Answer: x ≤ −3 or x ≥ 5

Common mistakes

  • Giving only one solution. |x + 3| = 7 has two: 4 and −10.
  • Splitting before isolating: in 3|x| − 2 = 10, first get |x| = 4.
  • Solving |x| = −3 as x = ±3. There is no solution.
  • Writing |x| < 4 as x < −4 or x > 4. Less than gives the part between: −4 < x < 4.

faq.q: How many solutions does an absolute value equation have?
faq.a: Usually two. |A| = k has two solutions when k > 0, one when k = 0 and none when k < 0.

faq.q: Why do I isolate the absolute value first?
faq.a: The rule |A| = k → A = ±k only works when the absolute value is alone on one side. Undo the other operations first.

faq.q: How do I solve |x − a| < k?
faq.a: Write it as −k < x − a < k and solve the three-part inequality. The solution is the numbers between a − k and a + k.

faq.q: How do I solve |x − a| > k?
faq.a: Write it as x − a < −k or x − a > k and solve each part. The solution is two rays going in opposite directions.

items.q: A machine fills bags with 500 g of rice. A bag is accepted if it is within 8 g of 500 g. Which inequality shows the accepted masses m?
items.e: “Within 8 of 500” means the distance from 500 is at most 8: |m − 500| ≤ 8.
